verses.1: Unto the end. To the servant of the Lord, David himself.
verses.2: The unjust one has said within himself that he would commit offenses. There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.3: For he has acted deceitfully in his sight, such that his iniquity will be found to be hatred.
verses.4: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He is unwilling to understand, so that he may act well.
verses.5: He has been considering iniquity on his bed. He has set himself on every way that is not good; moreover, he has not hated evil.
verses.6: Lord, your mercy is in heaven, and your truth is even to the clouds.
verses.7: Your justice is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are a great abyss. Men and beasts, you will save, O Lord.
verses.8: How you have multiplied your mercy, O God! And so the sons of men will hope under the cover of your wings.
verses.9: They will be inebriated with the fruitfulness of your house, and you will give them to drink from the torrent of your enjoyment.
verses.10: For with you is the fountain of life; and within your light, we will see the light.
verses.11: Extend your mercy before those who know you, and your justice to these, who are upright in heart.
verses.12: May arrogant feet not approach me, and may the hand of the sinner not disturb me.
verses.13: In that place, those who work iniquity have fallen. They have been expelled; they were not able to stand. [ Psalm 36 ] (37)
